facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan gives new users 75 starter credits, according to the vendor's page.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 75 credits to start, enough for your first video.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says its purchased credit packs start at $9.99 for 100 credits and never expire.
facts.quote: Credit packs start at $9.99 for 100 and never expire.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Starter plan is listed at $29 per month with 500 credits, up to 1080p, no watermark, and 3 seats.
facts.quote: Starter is $29/mo (500 credits, up to 1080p, no watermark, 3 seats).

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Pro plan is listed at $99 per month with 2,000 credits, API and MCP access, custom voice design, and 20% credit rollover.
facts.quote: Pro, the most popular tier, is $99/mo (2,000 credits, API and MCP access, custom voice design, 20% credit rollover).

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Business plan is listed at $299 per month with 8,000 credits, up to 4K, webhooks, and 25 seats.
facts.quote: Business is $299/mo (8,000 credits, up to 4K, webhooks, 25 seats).

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free tier exports at 480p with a watermark, per the vendor's page.
facts.quote: The free tier exports at 480p with a watermark, so you'll want a paid plan

facts.fact: According to the Wavemaker page, a finished Wavemaker video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting at $50.
facts.quote: a finished Wavemaker video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting at $50

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says its AI storyboard includes 21 presets.
facts.quote: AI storyboard (21 presets)

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says it offers a 13-tool MCP server.
facts.quote: a 13-tool MCP server (OAuth 2.1, webhooks, progress streaming)

facts.fact: The Wavemaker page claims InVideo's credits reset monthly and do not roll over, so unused credits are lost.
facts.quote: Credits reset monthly and don't roll over, so anything you don't use, you lose.

facts.fact: The Adwave page says VEED's paid plans start around $12 per month for an entry tier with 1080p export.
facts.quote: Paid plans start around $12/mo for the entry tier (1080p export)

facts.fact: The Adwave page says Pictory has no permanent free plan, only a free trial.
facts.quote: Pictory runs on a free trial rather than a permanent free plan

facts.fact: The Adwave page says Pictory's paid plans start around $23 per month for the Standard tier.
facts.quote: Paid plans start around $23/mo for the Standard tier

facts.fact: The Adwave page says Pictory's Premium tier is roughly $47 per month.
facts.quote: rising to roughly $47/mo for Premium and higher for teams

facts.fact: The Adwave page states that pricing figures are general ranges pulled from public pricing pages in 2026 and are not quotes.
facts.quote: treat every number here as a general range pulled from public pricing pages in 2026, not a quote

facts.fact: Lumen5 paid plans start around $19 per month, according to the page.
facts.quote: Paid plans start around $19/mo and climb for higher resolution, more brand controls, and team features.

facts.fact: Fliki paid plans start around $28 per month and go up to roughly $88 per month, depending on usage minutes and features.
facts.quote: Paid plans start around $28/mo and go up to roughly $88/mo depending on usage minutes and features.

facts.fact: Synthesia's entry-tier paid plan starts around $18 to $29 per month.
facts.quote: Paid plans start around $18 to $29/mo for the entry tier, with a Creator tier in the $64 to $89/mo range

facts.fact: Synthesia's Creator tier is in the range of $64 to $89 per month.
facts.quote: with a Creator tier in the $64 to $89/mo range and custom enterprise pricing above that

facts.fact: Synthesia's free plan is watermarked and includes roughly 10 minutes of video per month.
facts.quote: A limited free plan exists (watermarked, roughly 10 minutes a month).

facts.fact: Canva Pro runs roughly $15 per month or about $120 per year.
facts.quote: Canva Pro runs roughly $15/mo (or about $120/year), with team pricing above that.
